strings.IRIS_MAP_WMD_SR71_DESC: WMD's first half: the SR-71's airfield.
strings.MENU_ZOMBIE_MOON_DESC: I believe that this nation should commit itself to achieving the goal, before this decade is out, of landing a man on the moon and returning him safely to the Earth. (JFK, 1961)
strings.WAW_MENU_ZOMBIE_PROTOTYPE_DESC: You drove them deep into the heart of the Reich. You thought they were dead. You were wrong.
strings.WAW_MENU_ZOMBIE_ASYLUM_DESC: Electroshock therapy. Chemically engineered beverages. Hordes of undead Nazis. Find the power to unite and send them back to their graves!
strings.WAW_MENU_ZOMBIE_SUMPF_DESC: Maggot ridden corpses. Bug infested swamp. Hundreds of undead Imperial Army. Choose your tactic and defend for your lives!
strings.WAW_MENU_ZOMBIE_FACTORY_DESC: The Giant is rising. Face the might of the Nazi Zombies in their heartland. This is where the master plan took shape. Is this where it all ends?
